mapper.sql: select policy_id, tenant_id, name, description, enabled, is_system, priority, match_json, interval_value, interval_unit, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from crm_recall_policy
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and policy_id = #{policyId} limit 1
where del_flag = '0' and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and enabled = '1' order by priority asc
mapper.update: update crm_recall_policy set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, priority = #{priority}, match_json = #{matchJson}, interval_value = #{intervalValue}, interval_unit = #{intervalUnit}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'
update crm_recall_policy set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where policy_id = #{policyId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' and is_system = '0'
